description: Remaining backlog items for the Mistborn Allomancy RPG

tasks.title: Implement Feruchemy base system
tasks.description: Create Feruchemist.cs with metalminds for all 16 metals. Each metalmind stores/taps a specific attribute (steel=speed, iron=weight, pewter=strength, tin=senses, zinc=mental speed, brass=warmth, copper=memories, bronze=wakefulness, gold=health, electrum=determination, cadmium=breath, bendalloy=energy, aluminum=identity, duralumin=connection, chromium=fortune, nicrosil=investiture). Implement store/tap mechanics with diminishing returns. Reference the physics handbook at docs/PHYSICS-MATH-BOOK.md for Feruchemy storage formulas.
acceptance_criteria: Feruchemist.cs with store/tap for all 16 metalminds
Storage rate and tap rate with diminishing returns
Integration with existing Allomancer component for Compounding detection

tasks.title: Implement Compounding system
tasks.description: Create Compounding.cs that detects when a character has both Allomancy and Feruchemy for the same metal. Burning a metalmind Allomantically should produce a massive burst of the Feruchemical attribute (10x normal tap rate). This is how the Lord Ruler achieved immortality (gold compounding = infinite health). Reference AllomancyPhysicsFormulas.cs for compounding calculations.
acceptance_criteria: Compounding.cs that bridges Allomancer and Feruchemist
Integration with LordRulerBoss.cs for boss compounding behavior

tasks.title: Add Hazekiller squad AI with formation tactics
tasks.description: Expand HazekillerAI.cs with proper squad formations. Hazekillers use aluminum-lined helmets (immune to emotional Allomancy), carry non-metallic weapons, and work in coordinated squads. Implement triangle formation, flanking maneuvers, shield wall, and coordinated rush tactics. They should counter Allomancers specifically - spread out vs Coinshots, close range vs Lurchers.
acceptance_criteria: Squad formation system (triangle, shield wall, rush)
Anti-Allomancy tactics (spread vs push, close vs pull)
Squad leader designation and command relay

tasks.title: Implement Koloss rage scaling and sword mechanics
tasks.description: Expand KolossAI.cs with lore-accurate Koloss behavior. Koloss grow larger as they age, their skin tears and is held by stakes. Implement rage mode that increases damage/speed but reduces defense. Koloss swords are massive and should have area-of-effect ground slam attacks. Add Hemalurgic spike vulnerability - removing spikes makes them docile.
acceptance_criteria: Size scaling affects stats (larger = more damage, slower)
Koloss sword pickup for player after kill

tasks.title: Add Steel Inquisitor multi-phase boss fight
tasks.description: Expand SteelInquisitorAI.cs with a proper multi-phase boss fight. Phase 1: Uses Steel/Iron pushes and pulls aggressively. Phase 2 (below 60% HP): Burns Atium for future sight (dodge player attacks). Phase 3 (below 30% HP): Burns all metals simultaneously, extremely dangerous. Weakness: removing the linchpin spike from their back kills them instantly. Add spike-pulling mechanic when stunned.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct combat phases with transitions
Linchpin spike vulnerability (QTE or interact when stunned)
Proper death animation when spike removed

tasks.title: Create Lord Ruler final boss fight
tasks.description: Expand LordRulerBoss.cs into a full multi-phase final boss. Phase 1: Physical combat with Pewter enhancement and Steel pushes. Phase 2: Emotional Allomancy (Soothing/Rioting the player). Phase 3: Full Compounding with regeneration (gold compounding heals). Phase 4: Atium burn with time dilation. The player must discover the weakness (removing his metalminds stops his compounding). Add dramatic cutscene triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Emotional Allomancy affecting player (screen effects, debuffs)
Atium phase with predicted player movements
Metalmind removal mechanic to disable compounding

tasks.title: Implement dialogue system with branching conversations
tasks.description: Expand DialogueSystem.cs with proper branching dialogue trees. Support for speaker portraits, typing animation, response choices that affect story flags, skill checks (Allomancy-based dialogue options like 'Soothe the guard' requiring Brass), and quest trigger integration. Add dialogue for key NPCs: Kelsier, Breeze, Ham, Clubs, Sazed, Vin.
acceptance_criteria: Branching dialogue tree with multiple response options
Allomancy skill checks in dialogue (Zinc/Brass options)
Story flag integration (choices affect game state)

tasks.title: Add weather system integration with gameplay
tasks.description: Connect WeatherSystem.cs to gameplay mechanics. Mist should affect visibility and Tin effectiveness. Ash storms should deal damage without cover. Rain should affect sound detection ranges. Weather should cycle on a day/night schedule. The mists should be thicker at night (lore-accurate). Add mist spirit random encounter during deep mist.
acceptance_criteria: Weather affects Tin sight range and overload
Ash storm damage and screen effects

tasks.title: Implement coin pouch and projectile system
tasks.description: Create CoinPouch.cs for the Coinshot's primary weapon system. Players carry a pouch of coins that can be individually pushed. Implement coin throwing (aim + push), coin shotgun (multiple coins at once), coin bounce (push coin off ground for vertical launch), and coin trail (rapid-fire coins while moving). Each coin is a physics object with an AllomanticTarget component.
acceptance_criteria: Individual coin spawning as physics objects
Coin bounce off surfaces for repositioning

tasks.title: Add minimap with Allomantic metal detection overlay
tasks.description: Expand MinimapSystem.cs to show Allomantic metal sources when burning Bronze (Seeker ability). Metal sources should pulse on the minimap with color-coded indicators matching metal type. Add fog of war that clears as player explores. Show quest markers, checkpoint markers, and enemy positions (when using Tin enhanced hearing).
acceptance_criteria: Bronze burning reveals metal sources on minimap

tasks.title: Implement skill tree with Allomantic specializations
tasks.description: Expand SkillTreeSystem.cs with proper skill trees for each metal. Each metal should have 3 tiers of upgrades: Efficiency (reduce metal drain), Power (increase effect strength), Mastery (unlock special abilities). Add passive skills for combat, movement, and survival. Skill points earned from leveling up via PlayerExperience.
acceptance_criteria: 16 metal skill trees with 3 tiers each
Visual skill tree UI with node connections
Skill effects applied to corresponding metal scripts

tasks.title: Add environmental storytelling and collectible lore books
tasks.description: Create LoreCollectible.cs for finding books, notes, and journal entries throughout the world. Include excerpts from the Mistborn lore: the Deepness, the Lord Ruler's ascension, the Well of Ascension, Hemalurgy principles, skaa rebellion history. Each collectible unlocks an entry in a Lore Codex accessible from the pause menu.
acceptance_criteria: Lore Codex UI in pause menu
15+ lore entries covering key Mistborn topics
Achievement for finding all lore entries
